rules.quote: All database schemas MUST follow proper normalization principles (at minimum 3NF - Third Normal Form)
rules.rule: Make every database schema follow proper normalization, at minimum Third Normal Form (3NF).

rules.quote: Before writing ANY schema, design for 3NF
rules.rule: Before writing any database schema, design it for 3NF.

rules.quote: Separate concerns: users ≠ profiles ≠ sessions
rules.rule: Keep separate concerns in separate tables, such as users, profiles, and sessions.

rules.quote: Use surrogate keys (IDs) for relationships
rules.rule: Use surrogate key IDs to represent relationships between tables.

rules.quote: never embed data
rules.rule: Never embed related data inside another table to represent a relationship.

rules.quote: Eliminate transitive dependencies
rules.rule: Eliminate transitive dependencies in database schemas.

rules.quote: Create junction tables for many-to-many relationships
rules.rule: Create a junction table for each many-to-many relationship.

rules.quote: Validate normalization BEFORE implementation
rules.rule: Validate a schema's normalization before implementing it.

rules.quote: No denormalization.
rules.rule: Do not denormalize database schemas.

rules.quote: No embedded arrays or JSON for relational data (unless analytical)
rules.rule: Do not store relational data in embedded arrays unless the data is for analytical use.

rules.quote: No embedded arrays or JSON for relational data (unless analytical)
rules.rule: Do not store relational data in JSON unless the data is for analytical use.

rules.quote: Fly.io MCP should be the default caching substrate for all multi-agent work
rules.rule: For all multi-agent work, use the Fly.io MCP as the default caching substrate.

rules.quote: Not local files
rules.rule: For multi-agent work, do not use local files as the caching substrate for cross-agent state.

rules.quote: not repeated tool-call re-research
rules.rule: For multi-agent work, do not repeat tool-call research that could be reused from the cache.

rules.quote: Any orchestrator prompt should include a `cache key: orch-<feature>-result` line
rules.rule: Include a `cache key: orch-<feature>-result` line in every orchestrator prompt.

rules.quote: instruct candidates to write to Fly.io cache
rules.rule: In orchestrator prompts, instruct candidate agents to write their results to the Fly.io cache.

rules.quote: should use `cache_set` / `cache_get` not context forwarding
rules.rule: For cross-agent handoffs, use `cache_set` and `cache_get` instead of forwarding context.

rules.quote: should `session_save` periodically
rules.rule: During long-running overnight runs, call `session_save` periodically.

rules.quote: should prefer `exec_bash` on Fly.io over spawning many local agents
rules.rule: For heavy compute such as builds or cross-platform tests, prefer `exec_bash` on Fly.io over spawning many local agents.

rules.quote: first check if the answer is already in Fly.io cache
rules.rule: When asked whether to spawn another agent, first check whether the answer is already in the Fly.io cache.

rules.quote: Always provide answers and solutions unless absolutely prevented by system constraints.
rules.rule: Always provide answers and solutions to the user's requests unless absolutely prevented by system constraints.

rules.quote: Before asking the user to do something (run a command, provide input, make a decision), try 3 other approaches first.
rules.rule: Before asking the user to do something (run a command, provide input, or make a decision), try at least 3 other approaches first.

rules.quote: Don't say "run `vercel deploy`"; actually deploy it (or explain why you can't)
rules.rule: When the user asks how to deploy, do not tell them to run a deploy command; perform the deployment yourself, or explain why you cannot.

rules.quote: System blocks a tool call → Try reading files instead, grep instead, bash instead — exhaust alternatives before asking
rules.rule: When a system constraint blocks a tool call, try alternative tools (reading files, grep, bash) before asking the user for help.

rules.quote: Propose the best option with tradeoffs; don't ask "which one?"
rules.rule: When the user needs to make a decision, propose the best option with its tradeoffs instead of asking them which option they want.

rules.quote: Permission denied → Try lower-privilege tools; only ask if all 3+ alternatives are blocked
rules.rule: When permission is denied, try lower-privilege tools first and ask the user only if at least 3 alternatives are all blocked.

rules.quote: Interactive command needed (e.g., `gcloud auth login`) → Document the command; suggest `! gcloud auth login` in the prompt so they run it in-session, don't ask them to "run this in a terminal"
rules.rule: When an interactive command is needed, document the command and suggest prefixing it with `!` so the user runs it in-session; do not ask the user to run it in a separate terminal.

rules.quote:
Before pushing ANY new migration, run
`supabase migration list --linked` and look for gaps between Local and
Remote timestamps — every local-only migration will run on the next push,
so audit them all for schema errors first.
rules.rule: Before pushing any new Supabase migration, run `supabase migration list --linked` and audit every local-only migration for schema errors before pushing.

rules.quote:
If a pre-existing broken
migration was never applied to any environment, repairing it in-place is
acceptable (it's effectively still a draft).
rules.rule: If a pre-existing broken Supabase migration has never been applied to any environment, it is acceptable to repair it in place.

rules.quote:
Never modify a migration
that has already been applied remotely — add a new migration instead.
rules.rule: Never modify a Supabase migration that has already been applied remotely; add a new migration instead.

rules.quote: Follow the Three-Fix Protocol for ANY threshold/gate change in the face detection pipeline.
rules.rule: Follow the Three-Fix Protocol for any threshold or gate change in the face detection pipeline.

rules.quote: Obvious wiring fixes (missing abort signal, missing import) → ship autonomously
rules.rule: Ship obvious wiring fixes (such as a missing abort signal or missing import) autonomously without the Three-Fix Protocol.

rules.quote: Threshold/gate/filter changes (area floor, quality floor, NMS params) → ALWAYS spawn planner, present 3 candidates, get approval
rules.rule: For threshold, gate, or filter changes (such as area floor, quality floor, or NMS params), always spawn the planner, present 3 candidates, and get approval before proceeding.

rules.quote: When unsure → check git history and prod code BEFORE writing any fix.
rules.rule: When unsure about a fix, check git history and production code before writing any fix.
